svg.title: TabFM - classifier
svg.desc: Google - column and row stages run twice, then an in-context stack · 1.64 B parameters. Symbols in shapes: B: ensemble members (batch); n: rows in the context (train + test); p: raw features; F: feature groups; E: embedding width; n_test: test rows (the rows being predicted). Abbreviations: ICL: in-context learning: test rows attend to the labelled training rows; CLS: learned summary token that reads out a row or column; MLP: multilayer perceptron (the feed-forward sublayer); SwiGLU: gated linear unit with a Swish activation; RMSNorm: root-mean-square normalisation; QK: query and key (as in QK-norm); KV: keys and values (as in KV cache, KV heads). How to read: the data flows upwards, from the input table to the prediction; a line up the right-hand side ending in a circled plus: a residual connection, adding the input of the steps it passes back to their output; a box at the left meeting the flow at a circled plus: that stage's output is added to the flow; concat / prepend: a stage's output joins as an extra column, or as learned rows or columns put in front; N ×: the steps in the tinted container are stacked N times; small boxes at the left feed the step their arrow points to; dark boxes are attention; the line under the name says where its keys come from, which tokens query in the last block, how it is scaled, and how many key/value heads the test rows read; beside the arrows: the tensor shape each stage emits, in the symbols above; dotted lines: facts about the part they point to, with the numbers in the model's colour.
